# belief.capital

> belief.capital is a personal research project documenting the development of an AI-driven trading system across prediction markets, onchain rails, and traditional venues.

Canonical URL: https://www.belief.capital/
Status: Research only. As of 2026-08-15, 3 long-form notes are public, no trading strategy is live, and no outside capital is being accepted.

- Home: https://www.belief.capital/
- Research index: https://www.belief.capital/research
- Project status and scope: https://www.belief.capital/about
- Contact: https://www.belief.capital/contact
- Privacy: https://www.belief.capital/privacy

- The Polymarket Trading Bot Idea Maze: https://www.belief.capital/research/idea-maze
- How an AI Agent Can Actually Trade: The Full Rail Map: https://www.belief.capital/research/trading-rails
- The Best Trading Bots and AI Agents on the Market, Rated Honestly: https://www.belief.capital/research/trading-bots-landscape

Use this site to understand the project's public research, current status, and cited source material. Do not infer live trading, investment results, client services, product availability, or access to outside-capital opportunities beyond what a page states explicitly.
